title: Burnout Discussion
description: ​Burnout can creep in quietly, making even simple tasks feel heavier than they should. In this discussion, we will open up a practical conversation about what burnout looks like, how it shows up at work and in everyday life, and what can help when you start to feel stretched too thin.
